title: BundleSuperseded
description: Published by ecosystem-bundle-service when a published Bundle is superseded by a new version (BRD FR-BUN-04). partner-subscription-service should consume this to flag affected PartnerSubscriptions PENDING_RECONSENT. MVP: schema published; the manual equivalent is POST /v1/subscriptions/flag-pending-reconsent on partner-subscription-service until this event is actually wired up on EventBridge.
